speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Urinalysis: Appearance: Clear, WBC: 0-5 /HPF, RBC: 0-2 /HPF, Nitrites: Negative, Leukocyte_Esterase: Negative; Scrotal_Ultrasound: Findings: Decreased blood flow to the right testicle, suggestive of testicular torsion.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Testicular Torsion

The ultrasound findings showing decreased blood flow to the right testicle, combined with your history of sudden onset pain and high-risk sexual history, confirm the diagnosis of testicular torsion. This is a surgical emergency requiring immediate detorsion and orchiopexy.
